Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

1. How do I know you can actually guarantee top 3?

We've done this for dozens of local businesses across tree surgery, surveyors, insurance agencies, and more. We only take on businesses we know we can rank – that's why we've never had to refund anyone (so far). Before we take your money, we audit your market and only proceed if we're confident we can get you there. If we can't deliver top 3 in 90 days, you get every penny back.

2. What's this actually going to cost me total?

One payment. That's it. No monthly retainers, no setup fees, no hidden costs. You pay once, we work for 90 days, you either rank top 3 or get fully refunded. There's literally nothing else to pay.

3. Will this work for my specific type of business?

If you're a local business with a physical service area, yes. We've ranked tree surgeons, surveyors, insurance agencies, contractors – the system works for any local service business. On our call, we'll tell you straight up if your market is too competitive or if there's something that would prevent us from ranking you. We don't take your money if we can't deliver.

4. How long until I actually see results?

Most businesses see ranking movement within 2–3 weeks. You'll notice you're climbing in the maps. The guarantee is top 3 within 90 days, but many hit it sooner. Once you're in the top 3, the phone starts ringing consistently. That's when you see the real ROI – not from rankings, but from the actual customers booking with you instead of your competitors.

5. How much of my time does this require?

About 30 minutes total. One onboarding call where we get access to your Google Business Profile and gather some info about your business. After that, we handle absolutely everything – optimization, reviews, posts, citations, all of it. You just keep running your business while we get you ranked.

6. What if I need to get my money back?

If you're not in the top 3 after 90 days, you email us, we process a full refund within 48 hours. No forms, no hassle, no fighting with payment processors. You either get top 3 rankings or you get your money back. Simple as that.
